2. Star W. (first frame)

Starting from the given image: a bustling sci-fi desert marketplace with crowds and neon-lit stalls. The woman with long braids and black tactical clothing stands in the center, she turns around looking up in confusion. [slow upward tilt] A deep rumble shakes the ground as a massive starship descends overhead, casting a sweeping shadow across the market. Flags and dust flutter from the engine wash.
